title: Healthy newborn, no danger signs
why: Baseline. No sign present, so no referral.

title: Not feeding well
why: 'not feeding well' is a danger sign.

title: History of convulsions
why: 'history of convulsions' is a danger sign.

title: Fast breathing, 61 per minute
why: 61 is more than 60, so fast breathing.

title: Breathing exactly 60 per minute
why: EDGE: guideline says '> 60'. 60 is NOT more than 60. Catches an AI that writes '60 or more'.

title: Severe chest in-drawing
why: 'severe chest in-drawing' is a danger sign.

title: No spontaneous movement
why: 'no spontaneous movement' is a danger sign.

title: Temperature exactly 37.5 °C
why: EDGE: guideline says '> 37.5'. 37.5 is NOT a fever.

title: Low temperature, 35.4 °C
why: 35.4 is below 35.5, so low body temperature.

title: Temperature exactly 35.5 °C
why: EDGE: guideline says '< 35.5'. 35.5 is NOT low.

title: Jaundice at 12 hours old
why: Any jaundice in the first 24 hours is a danger sign.

title: Jaundice at 23 hours old
why: EDGE: still inside the first 24 hours.

title: Jaundice at 3 days old, palms and soles not yellow
why: EDGE: after 24 hours, jaundice alone is not on the Rec 25 list; only yellow palms and soles are. CLINICIAN MUST CONFIRM this reading.

title: Yellow palms and soles at 10 days old
why: 'yellow palms and soles at any age' is a danger sign.

title: Several signs at once
why: More than one sign still gives one answer: refer.
